messages:
tara-sales: quick sync: Prospect (Nimbus) wants Dedicated POC: reserve 5 GPUs, burst up to 20, but billing must never spike customer invoices. they asked for an 'elastic buffer' where over-burst spend above a monthly soft cap becomes a credit applied at 60% of list price. can we do that for a 30-day trial?
lee-ops: doable if we limit burst windows and region pin bursts to us-central. we can implement fallback to hosted in the same region when dedicated capacity unavailable. note: cold-start on burst replicas causes higher 95p latency for first 2 minutes.
ana-pricing: commercial idea: baseline 5 GPUs commit; burst +15 GPUs allowed, max 10 minutes per burst, 4 bursts/day. billing: baseline at commit rate; burst billed at discounted overage rate (POC discount 22%). soft cap on billed burst spend; any billed burst above soft cap -> converted to monthly credit at 60% list price. metering: 1-minute granularity.
devin-legal: will need a POC addendum with definition of soft cap, credit mechanics, rollback/throttle clause for abuse, and data residency clause. also request audit trail for all burst/fallback events.
billing-bot: sample calc (30-day POC, expected 6 bursts @ avg 8 GPUs for 8 minutes) => est $12,900 pre-discount. with 22% discount and 60% credit smoothing effective cost ~ $8,000. CSV: s3://redwood-poc/nimbus/2067789001-est.csv
tara-sales: please confirm us-central capacity and that KMS works for ephemeral burst instances. if all good i'll put this into deal-desk for approval with pricing@ and eng-runtime@.
lee-ops: on it, ETA 24h.
ana-pricing: will draft brief cost sensitivity table for deal-desk.
devin-legal: i'll start the addendum template.
tara-sales: thanks team — i'll loop in the customer after capacity confirm. :thumbsup:
